decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core skincare range with dedicated website visibility, it likely meets or is near aspiration levels and a small but established firm would usually keep it while demand becomes clearer.

The serum fits the firm's established offer and current market trends, so unless early sales clearly fell below aspiration levels the firm is likely to retain it, though its more limited prominence suggests somewhat higher review risk.

The cleansing milk is also close to the core business and benefits from existing know-how and channels, but with only basic website mention a small firm with limited slack would be somewhat quicker to redeploy resources if results stay below aspiration.
